verdict.rationale: ReadMe documents exporting your docs' source files or a PDF from the Branch menu, exporting via its API, and syncing Markdown to Git. These export the content, not a deployable static site you can host anywhere, so they count only as adjacent. Its documented hosting option is a custom domain on ReadMe itself, and no evidence shows a static-site export.

support.subject: As a developer, I can export my entire docs site as a static bundle and host it anywhere, so my content is never locked in

citations.quote: You can export the files in your docs or as a PDF from the Branch menu.
